project_identity.name: A tu Ritmo
project_identity.purpose: Videojuego educativo infantil para aprender ritmo, escucha y figuras musicales
project_identity.audience: Ninos y ninas, incluyendo jugadores con sindrome de Down

visual_language.concept: Interfaz musical calmada, tactil y guiada
visual_language.forms: rounded organic shapes with clear separation
visual_language.borders: soft cream outer borders with consistent dark inner separation
visual_language.lighting: gentle top-left volume, no harsh glare
visual_language.background_rule: simple low-contrast background with minimal decoration

typography.style: bold, rounded-feeling, high contrast, short labels

components.primary_button: wide rounded turquoise surface with editable label or Unity icon
components.life_indicator: three functional heart icons only in the life bar
components.timer: familiar analog clock plus progress bar, never hourglass
components.pulse_rings: Unity-generated subtle concentric rings around active board
components.feedback: temporary text/icon overlay, no permanent empty panel
components.simon_labels: editable D, G, E and C labels inside interactive zones

interactive_states.pressed: small scale reduction and darker surface
interactive_states.disabled: reduced saturation and opacity without losing silhouette
interactive_states.error: coral/red accent plus short shake, never aggressive flash

restrictions: Do not use full-screen mockups as in-game images
Do not replace functional controls with static artwork
Do not include decorative music notes or characters in the Simon background
Do not add permanent panels between the board and action buttons
Do not overwrite original assets without backup and approval
Do not integrate unapproved generated assets
